Caller map for the 13 renames, measured by AST at ce5795c6a5c. This is the implementation checklist and it quantifies the ADVI4 hazard.

Across the 8 pairs the 13 renames have **42 call-expression sites** and **39 parameter-name bindings**. The 39 are invisible to any rename that rewrites call expressions, because a pytest fixture is requested by the test function's parameter name.

| held-out module | definition | call-expr | param-bound |
|---|---|---|---|
| test_attest_registry_heldout.py | `_RecordingScheme` | 4 | 0 |
| test_attest_registry_heldout.py | `clean_registry` (fixture) | 0 | **6** |
| test_attest_registry_heldout.py | `_envelope` | 5 | 0 |
| test_audit_serve_heldout.py | `_plan_verdict` | 1 | 0 |
| test_audit_serve_heldout.py | `store` (fixture) | 0 | **5** |
| test_identity_3183_heldout.py | `store` (fixture) | 0 | **4** |
| test_identity_4e9d_heldout.py | `_events` | 6 | 0 |
| test_identity_4e9d_heldout.py | `store` (fixture) | 0 | **11** |
| test_identity_ac7_bff8_heldout.py | `_run` | 6 | 0 |
| test_identity_bde5_heldout.py | `_keypair` | 3 | 0 |
| test_identity_ts2_09f9_heldout.py | `_head` | 8 | 0 |
| test_identity_ts2_09f9_heldout.py | `store` (fixture) | 0 | **13** |
| test_rp04_s6_opcert_startup_heldout.py | `_cfg` | 9 | 0 |

Every fixture has **zero** call-expression sites. A rename driven by call sites touches none of them and reports success.

The `store` fixture the Approach omits — `test_identity_ts2_09f9.py` — carries the **largest** binding set of all 5 at 13. Implementing the enumerated 12 would have left those 13 bound to a shadowed fixture in the worst case in the story.

Two ordering constraints fall out:

1. In `test_identity_ts2_09f9_heldout.py`, `store` is a parameter of `_head` (`:63`), `_tracker` (`:59`), `_ticket_dir` (`:81`) and `_batched_keyadd_and_event` (`:193`) — helpers that are themselves being renamed or called. Renaming `store` means editing those helper **signatures**, not only test signatures.
2. `_head` is renamed in the same file, so its signature is rewritten by both renames. Apply them in one pass over the module, not two.

AC2's unchanged per-file `pytest --collect-only -q` counts is the check that catches a missed binding, since a stale parameter name raises a fixture-not-found error at collection.
